tex_content.html:
Definition

↗ prop:8-19

For a diffeomorphism $F\colon M\to N$ and $X\in \mathfrak {X}(M)$, the unique $F$-related field is the pushforward $F_*X$, given by \[ (F_*X)_q=dF_{F^{-1}(q)}(X_{F^{-1}(q)}). \tag {8.7} \]
